name: Wasos polling
info: Polls the WaSOS API at regular intervals to fetch chat messages. Checks configuration, builds authorized request, and returns messages for processing.

name: verify config
info: Validates that all required global variables are configured (wasos_apikey, rayvnConfig, rayvnLogId). Stops the flow with a warning if something is missing. This ensures both systems are configured before attempting to sync.

name: Headers function
info: Builds HTTP request to fetch chat messages from WaSOS. Sets x-api-key header and constructs URL from wasosChatroomUrl with ?limit=50 parameter to fetch the last 50 messages.

name: Get Wasos Chat Messages
info: Fetches chat messages from WaSOS API with GET request. Returns text (JSON) that needs to be parsed further.

name: Wasos Poll
info: Sends inject at regular intervals while the application is running.

Centralized error handler for this subflow.
Receives errors from the catch node and:
- Classifies and logs the error
- Sends notification to Rayvn and WaSOS
  if 5+ consecutive failures occur

and forwards them to the centralized
